title: Goober_cave_modpack
description: a modpack made for a group of friends. mixing food, create and magic for an overall fun vanilla style modpack
body:
hello gamers, this modpack is built for a discord friend group of a similar name. this pack has many mods, mostly ones to help the game run better on some pc's but also filled with cooking mods, deco mods and to adventure together! (with a small mix of magic and create mods)

this modpack was made to be vanilla friendly but still providing you with mods that enhance the minecraft experience overall, such as adding the create mod to allow you to build machines for automation and bringing your worlds to life. cooking mods such as farmers delight (with many more mods adding to this) to allow you to experience making large kitchens, shops and plenty of different food items making your world feeling more lived in and your own. and to top off the bigger mods there is ars and iron's spells to add a more magical and fantasy element to the game! these are all in this modpack to give friend groups a wide range of mods to play around with together! (using essential too for easy multiplayer worlds) and not to mention all of the decoration and building mods that will truly make your builds your own!

The pack also has a few resource packs and a shader that is lightweight for pc's to make the game look better, but you can add shaders and texture packs as you see fit!

i hope people will want to try this modpack out to enjoy playing with more to explore and create! hoping it is optimized well for many different ranges of pc's and giving everyone a smooth experience.

Also please check on the versions tab 
( https://modrinth.com/modpack/goober_cave_modpack/versions )
to see the mod list for the version of the modpack you want to download for a sneak peak at what is in store in full!
